The business is known for serving freshly prepared bagels, quality food, and beverages while providing outstanding customer service in a fast-paced retail environment. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing daily store operations, supervising staff, managing stock and inventory, maintaining high customer service standards, and ensuring the business operates efficiently and complies with food safety and workplace procedures. The Retail Manager will work closely with the team to drive sales, improve operational performance, and deliver an exceptional customer experience. Previous experience in a similar retail management role, strong leadership skills, and excellent organisational abilities are essential. Determine product range, stock levels, and customer service standards to meet business objectives and customer demand.  Develop and implement purchasing, pricing, promotional, and marketing strategies to maximise sales and profitability.  Promote and advertise the establishment's products and services through appropriate marketing initiatives and customer engagement activities.  Oversee the sale of goods and services, provide product information and recommendations to customers, and ensure a high standard of customer service.  Monitor and maintain accurate records of inventory, stock movements, sales, and financial transactions.  Prepare budgets, monitor operating expenses, and assist in achieving financial and sales targets.  Recruit, train, supervise, and evaluate staff, including allocating duties and monitoring employee performance.  Ensure adequate stock control procedures are maintained, including ordering, receiving, storing, and conducting regular stocktakes. Handle customer enquiries, complaints, and feedback in a professional and timely manner to maintain customer satisfaction.  Perform any other duties that are reasonable and within the scope of the Retail Manager position as directed. Strong  leadership  and  communication  skills  to  manage  and  motivate  the  team.   Ability to work in a fast paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.   About Company    NYC Bagel Company Pty Ltd (ABN: 63634406698), trading as NYC Bagel Deli, is a modern hospitality business dedicated to serving authentic New York-style bagels, freshly prepared meals, and premium coffee in a welcoming and customer-focused environment. The business is recognised for its commitment to quality ingredients, freshness, consistency, and exceptional customer service. NYC Bagel Deli offers a diverse range of bagels, sandwiches, breakfast items, and beverages while maintaining high food quality and professional service standards. Business: Harper Street Bakery & Café, Harvey WA
Position: Retail Supervisor
Address: 2 Harper St, Harvey WA 6220

AQF Certificate IV with at least 1 year of experience in a similar role

Roles and Responsibilities
Supervise daily front-of-house retail operations and report directly to the Store Manager.
Coordinate staff rosters, task allocation and service activities during busy trading periods.
Monitor customer service standards and assist staff in handling customer enquiries and complaints.

Monitor stock levels and communicate ordering or replenishment needs to the Manager.

Ensure compliance with food safety, workplace health and safety and store operating procedures.
Assist the Manager with opening and closing duties and maintain smooth day-to-day store operations.

Experience supervising staff in a bakery, café or retail food environment.
Strong customer service and communication skills.
Ability to coordinate daily operations and support team performance.
Knowledge of POS systems, cash handling and stock control procedures.
Understanding of food safety, hygiene and workplace safety requirements.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced bakery and café setting.

## ICT Support and Test Engineers (nec)
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
- Access ongoing learning and development opportunities, including support for professional certifications and industry training.
- Enjoy a flexible work environment with options for hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.
- Contribute to meaningful, large-scale ICT projects that have a real impact on organisational performance and service delivery.
- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description: Workinitiatives   Australia has a skills crisis. Workinitiatives is building the infrastructure to solve it. And we need someone to make sure every partner we bring on board actually crosses the finish line.   If you are the kind of person who thrives on getting things over the line, keeps ten plates spinning without dropping one, and finds genuine satisfaction in watching a partner go from signed to fully activated, keep reading.   What you will be doing   Working alongside our Manager of Marketing & Comms, this role sits at the intersection of content and performance, giving you direct ownership over the words that drive how people find and experience our platforms. You'll work alongside our Analytics Manager who handles the technical SEO foundation, so you can focus on what you do best: writing content that ranks and resonates.  Day to day that looks like:   Planning, writing, and editing SEO-optimised copy for Workinitiatives and partner platform web pages, landing pages, blog content, and other digital assets, following on-page best practices  Review, proofread, and optimise content across Workinitiatives' community platforms, ensuring location-specific pages and industry sector content is accurate, locally relevant, SEO-optimised, and published to standard across a range of industries and regions throughout Australia   Managing content publishing, maintenance, and link integrity to ensure information remains accurate, current, relevant, and owned by appropriate subject matter experts  Conducting regular keyword research to inform content gaps and priorities, messaging, and site experience  Leverage AI tools to support content production efficiency, including developing, testing, and refining prompts to improve output quality and streamline content workflows  Partnering closely with the Analytics Manager to align content output with technical SEO priorities and performance goals.  Using tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush) to track content performance and identify and implement improvements to enhance user experience and business outcomes.    What we are looking for   We are not prescriptive about your background. What we care about is your track record and your character.  You will be a natural fit if you have:   Proven experience in SEO copywriting, with a portfolio of published, search-optimised content.  Solid understanding of on-page SEO principles and how content supports organic search performance.  Experience with SEO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, or SEMrush.  Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with strong attention to detail.  Ability to translate performance data and technical SEO requirements into clear, engaging copy.  Strong project management skills and comfort juggling multiple content projects at once.  Collaborative mindset and clear communication skills for working closely with technical stakeholders.   A background in the following would be highly regarded and welcome:   Experience creating content within a specific industry or sector context, with the ability to adapt tone, terminology, and messaging for different audiences  A sound understanding of Australia's geographical regions, cultural nuances, and the diversity of communities across metropolitan, regional, and remote areas  Experience in the workforce development, employment services, or recruitment sector  Experience in website UX/UI principles and how content design choices affect usability and conversion.  Familiarity with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Webflow, or similar).  Experience with A/B testing or content optimisation based on user behaviour data.    Why Workinitiatives    A genuinely important mission, with real runs on the board  A lean, ambitious team that moves fast and trusts each other  Flexibility on location and how you work  The chance to build something, not just fill a role   About Company     Workinitiatives is an Australian social enterprise on a mission to solve the national skills crisis. We are not trying to disrupt the ecosystem. We are trying to connect it.    Through agnostic technology and a genuinely collaborative approach, we bring together jobs, skills, training, migration pathways, and regional development into a single infrastructure. We are headquartered at the Australian Computer Society offices in Barangaroo, Sydney, proudly Australian owned and operated.    We work with some of Australia's most respected peak bodies including the Australian Computer Society, NECA, Master Plumbers, Ageing Australia, VETASSESS, and the Australian Childcare Alliance, giving each a sector-specific platform to better serve their members and address workforce shortages in their industry.    We have also rolled out community-controlled jobs and skills platforms across every employment region in Australia, giving local communities the tools to attract, retain, and develop talent on their own terms.    Our customer success team is based in Queensland and we do the heavy lifting so our partners can focus on impact. result.description:
Colormaker Industries Australia is a well-established, family-owned manufacturer of quality coatings for interior and exterior application. Amongst a broad range of technologies, Colormaker also manufactures and exports market leading world class products in textile screen printing inks and high solids epoxy swimming pool coatings. The business is based on Sydney’s Northern Beaches.

We require a dedicated coatings & inks Quality Control (QC) Chemist to join our busy team of specialists in Brookvale, NSW.

Reporting to the Senior Chemist and Technical Manager, the duties and responsibilities of the role will include:

. Performing laboratory tests/QC procedures on paints and raw materials and recommending improvements for Factory Production and Product Development
. Preparing materials for test and/or experimentation
. Performing calculations, computations and measurements
. Analyzing test data results and preparing relevant reviews, reports and summaries
. Auditing and controlling the quality and quantity of materials used in QC tests, R&D and product maintenance
. Checking, calibrating and maintaining test equipment and other laboratory facilities
. Management of Safety Data Sheets, both Raw Materials and Finished Goods
. Technical and other support to Customer Service and Marketing, including translation of technical and other product literature
. Proficient use of Tencia/Arrow, Color I Control and relevant business software (including MS EXCEL). Also use of company systems
. Maintenance of relevant QC and Production records and related administration
. Adhering to appropriate workplace health and safety standards and making recommendations for improvement
. Management of Hazardous Materials and Dangerous Goods.
. Advising and sourcing materials for Research and Development (R&D) projects
. Carrying out product development work on new and existing products

We offer a competitive remuneration package of between $70,000 to $85,000 per annum, excluding superannuation.

The successful candidate will have either:

. A relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma plus five (5) years’ work experience; or
. At least ten (10) years of relevant full-time work experience

The successful candidate must have coatings experience. In particular, high solids epoxy, high performance industrial surface coatings, broad wall architectural and construction membranes etc would be highly regarded, as would knowledge of textile and other screen printing ink technologies. They must also be passionate about the environment, have a good eye for colour and for detail as well as an ability to work with minimal supervision. A high degree of numeracy and literacy in English are mandatory, whilst technical fluency in European languages would be highly regarded.  Applicants must have full and permanent working rights in Australia to be considered.

If you feel that you are suited to the role of Quality Control Chemist, then please send your CV to us via email technical@colormaker.com.au.
